note.text: Most value from AI will not come from whoever owns the biggest model, but from whoever rewires a workflow so completely that the old way becomes unthinkable. A search box, a logistics route, a hospital intake form — the unglamorous surfaces are where adoption actually compounds. Chasing the next benchmark win feels like progress, but shipping a slightly smarter version of something people already use every day is what changes behavior at scale. Start with the boring interface nobody wants to redesign.
